title: Emergency declaration EM-3633-KY: Winter Storm
summary: FEMA records a emergency declaration (EM-3633-KY, "SEVERE WINTER STORM") for KY, dated 2026-01-24, for an incident of type "Winter Storm". The incident period began on 2026-01-23 and ended on 2026-01-27. The declaration lists 120 designated areas.
